summary: Steel tower dated to 2008 by Alberta's register; a Lookout Network item dated 1995 reports fire damage and a quick repair at Algar.

access.note: Register lists the tower as active, with access coded Drive and a weather station. No source describes public visits.

events.note: Register year of construction for the present steel tower.

Heavy fire activity in June; newsletter item dated November 1995 says three steel lookout towers were evacuated and later burned over, Algar among them. A 1995 photo of Algar Tower is captioned in a Facebook post.
Newsletter says the heat melted aluminum bracing pipe and totally destroyed the engine house at Algar.
Repaired by mid-July, per the newsletter; the lookout returned to service.

notes_for_editor: Brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source. The register codes Algar as active with access Drive, so it is recorded as restricted with no visit information, as in ca-ab-athabasca. The 1995 account is a newsletter item reproduced on Canada Lookouts, so it is secondhand; its date is the item date, and the 1995 year also rests on a Facebook photo caption. The Facebook post body did not come through fetch_text, so only its title is quoted. No source gives a reason for the 2008 build or Algar-specific staffing; the staffing sentence is the province-wide statement. The brief has no local_unit, so the story says Alberta only. The 2008 date is taken to mean the present tower postdates the 1995 fire; the sources do not describe what happened to the site between 1995 and 2008.
